title: Cloudflare Dashboard and API service issues, fix implemented 26 November
geo_basis: headquarters; the status page names no location
summary: Cloudflare's status page says it investigated issues with the Dashboard and related APIs, and customers may have seen failed requests or errors. Cloudflare says cached file serving via the CDN and other edge security features were not affected. It posted that a fix had been implemented and it was monitoring the results. The page gives no cause.
plain: Cloudflare's status page says its dashboard and APIs had problems, with failed requests or errors possible. Cloudflare says a fix was implemented and it is monitoring.
exec: Cloudflare's own status page records a Dashboard and API incident; it says CDN cached file serving was not affected.

evidence.quote: Cloudflare is investigating issues with the Dashboard and related APIs.

validation.note: Cloudflare's own status page only; cause not stated there.
